Pipino.timing_note: Planning estimate within the guide's 38–45 days for slicing cucumber; variety and planting conditions affect timing.
Pipino.timing_note_fil: Tantya mula sa 38–45 araw sa gabay para sa slicing cucumber; nakadepende sa uri at kondisyon ng taniman.
Pipino.guidance: Provide drainage and a trellis, especially during rainy months.
Pipino.guidance_fil: Maghanda ng maayos na daluyan ng tubig at balag, lalo na sa tag-ulan.
Pipino.short_description: Suited to warm weather; needs drainage in rain
Pipino.short_description_fil: Angkop sa mainit na panahon; kailangan ng daluyan ng tubig kapag umuulan
Pipino.weather_note: The DA guide gives about 30°C as the optimum growing temperature and recommends raised beds and drainage during the wet season. Warm-weather suitability does not mean tolerance to extreme heat or drought.
Pipino.weather_note_fil: Ayon sa gabay ng DA, nasa 30°C ang angkop na temperatura sa paglaki. Inirerekomenda ang mataas na taniman at daluyan ng tubig sa tag-ulan. Hindi ito nangangahulugang matibay sa matinding init o tagtuyot.
Pipino.scoring_note: Seasonal indices and weather scores are illustrative AgriFarm planning heuristics, not DA–ATI measurements, harvest quantities, probabilities, or verified Pasig yields. Rainy months receive a lower seasonal fit because the guide cautions against waterlogging.
